title: Tech Domain Roadmap Generator
summary: A personalized learning-path recommendation tool that suggests structured tech roadmaps using classical ML algorithms like Decision Trees, KNN, and Random Forest via a Streamlit interface. An auxiliary script, additional_models/gan.py, imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to fit a CTGAN model on tabular data for synthetic data generation experiments.

needs: Unclear whether gan.py is actually invoked by the main roadmap app or is an unused/experimental side script
